hypothesis: High short interest plus price/event strength may identify squeeze-ready existing Ginger candidates, but only if point-in-time short-interest/borrow-pressure data is available with publication lag; this round audits availability and creates a shadow-only data-gap record.
single_causal_variable: point-in-time short-interest and borrow-pressure data availability for existing candidates

historical_experiment_check.playbook_status: listed as external alpha source priority 4, shadow-quality until PIT data exists
mechanism_insight_blockers: Do not treat FINRA daily short volume as short interest.
Do not promote external overlays without point-in-time source coverage.
Do not connect new external data to production signal path on first audit.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

bias_notes: Short-interest settlement dates are not tradable without publication dates.
FINRA daily short volume is trading activity, not short positioning.
News headline mentions are not structured borrow-pressure evidence.
Without borrow_fee or shares_available, squeeze confidence must be downgraded.

forward_return_of_tagged_candidates.reason: No point-in-time short/borrow rows exist to tag candidates.

scarce_slot_opportunity_cost.reason: No tagged candidates; cannot compare squeeze overlay candidates against same-day A/B slot alternatives.

false_positive_examples: Headlines using 'squeeze' for supply or cash-flow pressure are not short-squeeze data.
A headline mentioning short interest lacks exchange settlement/publication fields.
Future FINRA daily short-volume rows must not be interpreted as short-interest positioning.

expected_value_score_delta.reason: Data audit only; no replay, no production path, and no taggable candidates.

gate4.reason: No strategy behavior changed and no replay was possible without PIT source data.

decision_rationale: The mechanism is worth keeping on the external-alpha roadmap, but this run found no local point-in-time short-interest, FINRA short-volume, or paid borrow data. A shadow overlay would be fabricated if run now.
next_action: Add a default-off, append-only short-interest/borrow data adapter contract with publication-date lag handling before any shadow score or replay.
